run_make_parallel_single_runs: run the script to generate parallel single language run commands for all languages in a dump directory
generate_parallel_commands: generate shell commands to run single language inference for each language subdirectory in a dump folder
list_language_dirs: list all language subdirectories in a dump directory for parallel processing with fairseq
print_run_single_lang_commands: print python run_single_lang.py commands with absolute paths for each detected language directory
setup_parallel_lid_rerank: set up parallel language identification reranking runs across multiple languages using a fairseq model
